title: The Sky-Fallen Legacy
synopsis: A 13-episode sci-fi series from The Reality Foundry, made with Dreamina and Pippit AI, released July through October 2026.

audienceReactions.quote: Really liked this first episode and unlike so many stories of this kind, not everybody in the universe has to speak English. The visuals are excellent. Eager to see how the story develops. Great work!
audienceReactions.author: @sergiokodemo6925

audienceReactions.quote: The camera movements and space environment look incredibly smooth!
audienceReactions.author: @aiscififilms

audienceReactions.quote: This looks very consistent, I really like this. Best AI I ever seen.
